national_news.title: Govt Announces 5 Lakh Pucca Houses for Odisha under PMAY-Gramin
bullets: Union Minister for Rural Development Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced five lakh pucca houses for poor families in Odisha under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin.
The Centre and the Odisha state government will jointly provide subsidies for installing solar panels on houses to reduce electricity bills to zero and generate surplus income.

Odisha achieved its target of 27 lakh Lakhpati Didis a year ahead of schedule, with 29 lakh women now attaining the status, alongside a pan-India target of extending 10 lakh crore rupees in bank loans over the next five years.

national_news.title: PM Modi Participates in Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas Marking Birsa Munda's Birth Anniversary
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi participated in the Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas programme in Gadchiroli, Maharashtra, marking the 151st Birth Anniversary of Dharti Aaba Bhagwan Birsa Munda.
Inaugurated and laid the foundation stone for 246 development projects worth around three thousand crore rupees aimed at tribal welfare.
Key projects include the inauguration of 38 Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) and 100 Multi-Purpose Centres under PM-JANMAN and the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan (DAJGUA).

national_news.title: Railways Approves Weekly Train Service Between Janakpur Dham and Ayodhya
bullets: Indian Railways approved a new weekly train service connecting Janakpur Dham in Nepal with Ayodhya Cantt. in Uttar Pradesh, covering a distance of 604 kilometres.
The service passes through several towns and cities in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, including commercial stoppages at Jaynagar, Madhubani, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, and Narkatiaganj.
The initiative aims to enhance cross-border connectivity, religious tourism, and bilateral cultural ties under the Ramayana tourism circuit.

national_news.title: India Clinches Men's U-19 Asia Cup Title for Ninth Time
bullets: India defeated Pakistan by one wicket in the final of the Men’s Under-19 Asia Cup held in Muscat, Oman.
India successfully chased down a target of 338 runs, with Mohit Ulva scoring an unbeaten 49 and sealing the record-extending ninth title on the final delivery.
Mohit Ulva was named player of the match, and Aaryavir Sehwag was awarded player of the tournament.

national_news.title: 57th IFFI 2026 in Goa to Feature BRICS Films Showcase
bullets: The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) 2026 will be held in Goa from 20th to 28th November.
A special curated section 'Films from BRICS' will feature 21 films exploring themes of democracy, freedom, and social change from countries like Brazil, South Africa, China, and others.
India's official entry in the BRICS section is the film 'Article 370', directed by Aditya Dhar.

national_news.title: Lalremsiami Hmar Becomes First Sportsperson from Mizoram to Receive Arjuna Award
bullets: Indian women's hockey player Lalremsiami Hmar received the Arjuna Award from President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
She has made history by becoming the very first sportsperson from the state of Mizoram to be honored with the prestigious Arjuna Award.
Her notable career achievements include competing in the Tokyo Olympics 2020 and winning gold at the 2026 Asian Games.

national_news.title: PM Modi Launches Development Projects Worth Rs 15,600 Crore in Bengaluru
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched development projects worth over Rs 15,600 crore in Bengaluru, Karnataka, spanning metro, railways, and energy infrastructure.
Highlighted that India's renewable energy capacity has crossed 300 gigawatts, bolstered by initiatives like PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana and PM-KUSUM.
Inaugurated key energy projects including the Mangaluru LPG project (80,000 metric tonnes storage), Devangonthi Marketing Terminal, and a compressed biogas plant in Bengaluru.

national_news.title: Environment Minister Reviews Delhi-NCR Air Pollution Mitigation Measures
bullets: Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav chaired a review meeting with officials from Delhi, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and Rajasthan to tackle NCR air pollution.
Directed the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) to immediately seal 191 non-conforming polluting industries failing to install Air Pollution Control Devices.
Mandated state governments to nominate Secretary-level officials for specific cities to oversee anti-pollution measures and report weekly to the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM).

national_news.title: India Records All-Time High Exports of Nearly USD 90 Billion in October
bullets: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced that India's exports reached an all-time high of nearly USD 90 billion in October, comprising USD 50 billion in merchandise and USD 40 billion in services.
Cumulative exports for the first seven months of the financial year reached USD 570 billion, keeping the country on track to hit its USD 1-trillion export target.
India, currently a USD 4 trillion economy, aspires to scale up to a USD 30 trillion economy by 2047 in alignment with the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.

national_news.title: National Tribal Cultural Festival 'Bhagwan Birsa Kala Sangam 2.0' Begins in Maharashtra
bullets: The National Tribal Cultural Festival 'Bhagwan Birsa Kala Sangam 2.0' began in Gadchiroli, Maharashtra, marking the 151st birth anniversary of tribal freedom fighter Bhagwan Birsa Munda.
The event is organized by the Tribal Development Department of the Maharashtra Government and was attended by Union Tribal Affairs Minister Jual Oram.
Gadchiroli was chosen to host the main national celebration of Janjatiya Gaurav Divas following its transformation from a Naxal-affected district to Naxal-free.

national_news.title: CCPA Imposes ₹10 Lakh Penalty on Ride-Hailing Platform for Pre-Ride Tipping Prompt
bullets: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA), headed by Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare, penalized a cab platform ₹10 lakh for employing dark patterns via pre-ride tipping prompts.
The pre-ride tipping practice was declared an unfair trade practice, violating Clause 14.15 of the Motor Vehicles Aggregators Guidelines, 2025.
Guidelines mandate that tipping prompts can strictly be offered to consumers only after the completion of a journey.

national_news.title: WHO Global TB Report Highlights 38% Reduction in India's TB Mortality Since 2015
bullets: Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda highlighted findings from the WHO Global TB Report 2026, recording a 38% decline in India's TB mortality since 2015, outperforming the global average of 35%.
India achieved a 94% treatment success rate for drug-susceptible TB, covering over 25 crore people under intensified screening in the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.
Key initiatives driving success include AI-enabled diagnostics, financial/nutritional support through Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana, and community engagement via Ni-kshay Mitras.

national_news.title: 3rd ASEAN-India Development and Cooperation Report Released in New Delhi
bullets: Secretary (East) in MEA, Rudendra Tandon, released the 3rd edition of the ASEAN-India Development and Cooperation Report (AIDCR) 2026 titled 'Navigating Global Uncertainties and Strengthening Partnerships'.
The report release precedes Prime Minister Narendra Modi's upcoming visit to Manila for the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit.
Focus areas of engagement under India's Act East Policy include trade integration, maritime security, and Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR).

national_news.title: NSEIX Expands Indian Investors' Access to European Markets via GIFT City Platform
bullets: NSE International Exchange (NSEIX) expanded its global investment platform into seven European markets via its entity NSEIX Global Access IFSC Limited in GIFT City.

The expanded framework provides Indian investors access to over 11,500 securities and 8,200 Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) ETFs across European nations including France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Switzerland, and the UK.
NSEIXGA operates under the regulatory framework of the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) to facilitate cross-border diversification.

national_news.title: CBDT Implements Special Campaign 6.0 for Swachhata and Administrative Efficiency
bullets: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) implemented Special Campaign 6.0 across all field formations of the Income Tax Department following guidelines from the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG).
The campaign freed up 1.54 lakh sq ft of office space, generated Rs 36.9 lakh in revenue from scrap sales, weeded out over 90,000 physical files, and disposed of 29,153 public grievances.
Key regional initiatives included the installation of a zero-cost 'Waste to Art' structure named 'Gaj-Garuda' made from scrap materials at the Income Tax Office in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

national_news.title: Government Merges Central Bureau of Communication with Press Information Bureau
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) merged the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) with the Press Information Bureau (PIB) at the headquarters level into a single unified entity named PIB.
The unified organization will be headed by the Director-General (Coordination), PIB, New Delhi, who will report directly to the Chairman of the Communication Board.
CBC was originally created on December 8, 2017, by integrating the Directorate of Advertising and Visual Publicity (DAVP), Directorate of Field Publicity (DFP), and Song and Drama Division (S&DD).

national_news.title: MIB Restructures PIB and CBC Under Unified Organisational Framework
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting issued an office memorandum establishing a functional integration of CBC into PIB, placing all Additional Director General (ADG)-level officers under DG (Coordination), PIB.
Communication and Media Coordinators (CMCs) posted across central ministries and state-level offices will report to the DG (Coordination) to streamline 360-degree media planning.
The restructured entity is organized into functional verticals covering media advertising, outreach exhibitions, New India Samachar, print booklets, fact-checking, and social media facilitation.

national_news.title: PM Inaugurates India's First LED Dome Planetarium 'COSMOS-Mysuru'
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated 'COSMOS-Mysuru', India's first LED Dome Planetarium, in Mysuru, Karnataka.

The address showcased key ISRO milestones including Chandrayaan-3, Aditya-L1 solar observatory, and the Space Docking Experiment (SpaDeX), which made India the fourth nation to demonstrate space docking.
Practical satellite technology applications were highlighted, including ISRO's real-time train tracking collaboration with Indian Railways and cyclone warning systems for maritime safety.

national_news.title: MIB Merges PIB and CBC into Single Administrative Structure
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) functionally merged the Press Information Bureau (PIB) and the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) into a single entity operating under the PIB name.
The merged headquarters in New Delhi will be led by a newly created Director General (Coordination), PIB, reporting to the Chairperson of the Communication Board.
R K Jain, former Director General (News) at All India Radio's News Services Division, has been appointed as DG (Coordination), PIB.

national_news.title: Government Integrates PIB and CBC Media and Advertising Operations
bullets: The functional integration brings central government media relations, advertising, publicity, research, and fact-checking under a unified administrative framework.
Additional Director General (ADG)-level officers and Communication and Media Coordinators (CMCs) across central ministries will report to the DG (Coordination), PIB.
The initiative builds upon the 2022 regional office integration and will be extended to state and branch offices in phases.

national_news.title: MIB Restructures PIB and CBC Headquarters in New Delhi
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting ordered the administrative consolidation of PIB and CBC headquarters into one entity named Press Information Bureau.
The new structure unifies print advertising, audio-visual publicity, social media outreach, exhibitions, and media coordination under one leadership.
Former AIR News Services Division DG R K Jain was appointed to lead the integrated PIB setup as DG (Coordination).

national_news.title: Cabinet Approves ₹3,230 Crore Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at North and South Block
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved the development of the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum in New Delhi at an estimated cost of ₹3,230 crore.
The national project involves adaptive reuse of the historic North and South Block complex while preserving their original architectural character and heritage significance.
Appraised by the Public Investment Board (PIB), the implementation of the civilisational museum will take place in phases between FY 2026–27 and FY 2030–31.

bihar_news.title: BIADA Restores 42-Acre Land Allotment to United Breweries in Patna
bullets: The Bihar Industrial Area Development Authority (BIADA) restored a 42-acre leasehold land plot at Kopakalan Industrial Area in Patna to United Breweries Ltd (UBL).
The restoration was granted under Bihar's Amnesty Policy 2025 after UBL withdrew its pending writ petition in the Patna High Court.
The conditions require UBL to achieve trial production within 18 months and commercial production within 24 months, with annual lease charges set at ₹14.62 lakh.

bihar_news.title: Government Defends Namami Gange Programme Following Bloomberg Pollution Report
bullets: A decade after its launch, the Namami Gange programme has seen an expenditure of ₹43,060 crore toward cleaning the river.
A Bloomberg investigation utilizing satellite data and water tests around Kanpur and Varanasi reported persistent pollution in large stretches of the river.

The government countered the findings, stating that a 2,500 km river spanning multiple states cannot be comprehensively assessed through samples from just 12 locations, while acknowledging that pollution management remains ongoing work.

bihar_news.title: IICA Convenes Stakeholder Consultation on Public Policy Professionals
bullets: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), backed by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, convened a stakeholder consultation in New Delhi.
The initiative aims to define the evolving role of public policy professionals and strengthen capacity-building frameworks at the intersection of business and government.
Discussions focused on bridging public and private sectors, multidisciplinary skill development, and fostering institutional capacity for informed policymaking.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Promotes 10 IAS Officers to Additional Secretary Rank
bullets: The Bihar government promoted 10 IAS officers of the 2018 batch to the Additional Secretary rank (Pay Level 12), effective January 1, 2027.
Promoted officers include district magistrates from Katihar, Sheohar, Saran, Araria, Madhepura, Sheikhpura, Arwal, Buxar, Munger, along with the Director of Secondary Education.
The promotions are conditional upon the completion of Phase III of the mandatory Mid-Career Training Programme (MCTP) in upcoming sessions.

bihar_news.title: Bihar NEET PG 2026 Round 1 Results Released by BCECEB
bullets: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) released the Round 1 results for NEET PG admissions under state quota seats.
The counseling process covers MD, MS, PG Diploma, and DNB programs across various medical colleges in Bihar.
Unreserved category admission for Obstetrician-Gynecologist specialty ranges between ranks 162 and 1199 in participating state medical colleges.

bihar_news.title: Study Highlights High Burden of Premature Menopause and Hysterectomy in Bihar
bullets: Data from NFHS-5 and recent studies indicate a high burden of premature menopause among women aged 30–39 in Bihar, largely associated with hysterectomies.
The studies reveal a strong education gradient, where women with the lowest education levels are significantly more likely to undergo early hysterectomy and experience premature menopause.
Experts emphasize the need for urgent policy attention towards women's healthcare, clinical governance of hysterectomies, and long-term health awareness.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Inspects Patna Sahib-Patna Ghat Link Road Project
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister inspected the under-construction 1.5-kilometre link road connecting Patna Sahib Railway Station to Patna Ghat under the JP Ganga Path project.
The project is being constructed at a cost of Rs 52.54 crore, with work commencing on April 5, 2025.
The link road includes a flyover on Ashok Rajpath and aims to ease traffic congestion and improve connectivity in Patna City.

bihar_news.title: India's Longest River Bridge Named 'Nitish Setu', Set for Inauguration
bullets: The newly built six-lane Kacchi Dargah-Raghopur-Bidupur bridge over the Ganga has been officially named 'Nitish Setu' after former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar.
At 19.76 km including approach roads, it is India's longest river bridge, surpassing Assam's Bhupen Hazarika Setu.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the bridge on November 21, connecting Patna to Vaishali district.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Set Up 44 Hi-Tech Sugarcane Nurseries with Subsidy Support
bullets: The Sugarcane Industries Department of Bihar has introduced a scheme to establish 44 hi-tech sugarcane nurseries across the state to produce quality, disease-free planting material.
The initiative targets the annual production of approximately 2.20 crore improved sugarcane seedlings using the single-bud plantlet technique.
The government will provide a subsidy of up to 75% of the project cost, capped at Rs 11.25 lakh per nursery, with applications invited via the Bihar Cane Care portal.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranks Ninth Globally in Worth a Journey's 2026 Rankings
bullets: The Bihar Museum in Patna secured the ninth position on German travel guide Worth a Journey's 2026 list of the world's 100 best museums.
It stands as the highest-placed museum in Asia and the sole Indian institution on the prestigious list, outranking major global institutions like the Louvre (Rank 31).
The 13.9-acre complex houses over 20,000 artefacts, featuring iconic historical exhibits such as the 3rd-century BCE Didarganj Yakshi carved from Chunar sandstone.

bihar_news.title: Tigers to be relocated to Buxa Tiger Reserve from Assam and Bihar
bullets: West Bengal announced plans to relocate two tigers from Assam and Bihar to Buxa Tiger Reserve (BTR) by the end of November 2026 to strengthen its resident population.
The tiger recovery initiative is supervised by the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) and supported by the Wildlife Institute of India (WII).
On October 2, 2026, a three-year-old tigress (T138) was translocated from Valmiki Tiger Reserve, Bihar, to Buxa Tiger Reserve as part of this phased reintroduction programme.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranked 9th in World's Top 100 Museums List
bullets: Patna's Bihar Museum ranked 9th on German travel guide 'Worth a Journey's' list of the world's 100 best museums for 2026, making it the highest-placed museum in Asia and the only Indian entry.
The 13.9-acre complex was designed by Japanese firm Maki and Associates along with Mumbai-based OPOLIS, and officially opened its initial galleries in August 2015.
Key exhibits include the iconic 3rd-century BCE Didarganj Yakshi, a 5-foot-2-inch Chunar sandstone sculpture discovered near the Ganga River in Patna in 1917.
